name: User Management

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Default
nodes.description: Main user list table: User, Role, Token Status, Account Status, Last Activity, Actions; 5 rows covering role/token/account state variety; one disabled Deactivate button; pagination.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Loading
nodes.description: Skeleton state using 5x Skeleton=Table Row instances.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Error
nodes.description: Reused Error State component with custom copy.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Empty
nodes.description: Reused Empty State component depicting a filtered-search-with-no-results scenario.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / User Detail
nodes.description: Full user detail/expansion: identity, Token Status card, Account Status card, activity timeline, action row.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Confirm Deactivate
nodes.description: Confirmation modal (reused Dialog=Confirmation), primary action recolored to danger red for destructive action.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Action Success
nodes.description: Success Alert banner + updated row state + new Reactivate secondary action.

nodes.name: Admin / Users / Mobile
nodes.description: Mobile responsive variant: drawer nav, stacked single-column user cards, full-width action buttons.

checks: Self-audit against docs/figma/FIGMA_SCREEN_CHECKLIST.md passed for all 8 frames
Zero frame overlap verified via AABB check across all 33 frames on the Admin page
120px min separation exceeded (1560px column gaps, 1184px/700px row gaps)
All fills/strokes/radii bound to Color/Radius variables (Light/Dark modes resolve automatically)
No raw secrets/tokens shown anywhere; only status labels
knownIssues: No formal reusable Avatar component exists in the design system yet; an inline initials-in-circle equivalent was built from existing color tokens per frame. Recommend promoting to a real library component in a future foundation pass (owned by M00).
No dedicated tablet frame was created, consistent with existing precedent set by other Admin-area screens (Review Queue, Scan Rules, Templates, Workers) which also only have Desktop + Mobile.
notes: REMOVED: No longer applicable — product has no end-user accounts to manage after scope correction on 2026-08-17. Confirmed target scope has NO end-user accounts, NO user-facing GitHub OAuth login, and NO per-user dashboard/findings/tokens pages. Admin (via email+password Credentials provider) is the only authenticated role, and the only 'user management' surface is now the admin-only Tokens view (apps/web/app/(protected)/admin/tokens/page.tsx), which is in scope for a corrected module, not M11.
Do not build the Admin / Users / * Figma screens listed above. They were designed under the pre-correction product scope and are obsolete.
No other module's frames were touched, moved, or modified during this work.

This status change (CLAIMED -> REMOVED) was made directly per explicit user/product-owner instruction as part of the scope-correction task; it is not a self-declared DONE and does not close out the module through the normal verify-module flow.
